items.title: ReactOOPS
items.summary: A Next.js application vulnerable to **CVE-2025-55182** — a critical Remote Code Execution flaw in Next.js Server Actions that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands on the server.

items.title: Terminal Adventure
items.summary: A browser-based terminal adventure game. The goal is to bypass client-side input validation and interact with the backend API directly to extract the flag.
